name: Run the unified Loop B + Loop A closed-loop harness cycle
description: Execute the full autonomous Loop B and Loop A cycle on a GCP lab VM: harvest production and canary failures, expand the benchmark curriculum for saturated roles, diagnose four-lens bottlenecks with the Frontier Model Committee, evolve single-lens candidates under the Capability-First Credo, and promote winning branches as GitHub pull requests against the primary repository.
narrative:
1. Validate the candidate repository checkout with `harness-cycle --action validate --repo . --json`.
2. Run Loop B failure harvesting and curriculum expansion with `harness-eval --action harvest --stage all --expand-curriculum --persist --json`.
3. Evaluate baseline benchmark suites with the Frontier Model Committee via `harness-eval --action evaluate --stage all --trials 2 --live --judge-committee --include-harvested --json`.
4. Diagnose four-lens bottlenecks across roles with `harness-cycle --action diagnose --stage all --trials 2 --live --judge-committee --json`.
5. Run Loop A recursive evolution under the Capability-First Credo with `harness-cycle --action run --stage all --iterations 2 --candidates 2 --trials 2 --live --vertex --judge-committee --include-harvested --expand-curriculum --json`.
6. Verify promotion gates and open a pull request against the primary repository with `harness-promote --action verify --repo . --stage all --trials 2 --live --vertex --judge-committee --apply --push-pr --json`.
